title: Least presence and complete module withdrawal
summary: The October 2026 PHP vulnerability lesson is that installed or enabled handlers can survive removal of the application that introduced them. Narrow modules plus enforced RexxOS service isolation require lifecycle-closed capabilities.
invariants: Every activation has an owner, purpose, route/listener registration, authority grant and inspectable evidence.
Installation alone cannot silently activate public-facing handlers.
Application uninstall withdraws no-longer-owned listeners, routes, dispatch registration, authorization and credentials.
Withdrawal proves negative reachability, not just file removal.
Shared capabilities use explicit dependency tracking so neither orphaned privilege nor premature withdrawal is acceptable.
Isolation is enforced at runtime and is not synonymous with a directory structure.
